selectionRule: Census of all 16 posts in the sole eligible post-WP1 ordinary edition; review originals including all discussion turns.

gate.cultureCoverage: Philosophy and film reviewed; no mythology or Sopranos item in this edition. Supplement later samples with a second unambiguous culture topic.

posts.title: XRISM Sees a Star’s Wind Power Its Companion’s Flares

claims.claim: Wind captured by a compact companion powers X-ray flares; BP Crucis is about 13,000 light-years away in Crux.
claims.review: Selected S2E1/S2E2/S2E7 and the NASA page support the entity, mechanism, approximate distance and location.

claims.claim: Wind-to-flare chain and the opportunity to test the process.
claims.review: S2E2/S2E6/S2E7 support both turns; no material extra factual claim.

posts.title: A Qwen Tool on the Federal Register Was Removed

claims.claim: Federal Register Qwen search was removed after attention; Alibaba was named among six firms in an FBI allegation.
claims.review: Page supports sequence and reported allegation. S10E4 is a partial sentence; it preserves the allegation marker but is not a full account.

claims.claim: Distinguishes deployment choice from allegations about model development.
claims.review: Supported interpretation of S10E1/S10E2/S10E4; no finding of wrongdoing asserted.

posts.title: Two Profit Measures, Two Different Stories

claims.claim: After-tax profits surged while adjusted pre-tax profits changed less.
claims.review: Selected S5E5/S5E6/S5E7 instead concern industrial/manufacturing production and a chart. Attached page has no profit comparison. Separate profit article attached to post 10 supports the body.

claims.claim: After-tax and adjusted pre-tax profit are different measures.
claims.review: Interpretation is defensible for the replacement source, not the originally attached production evidence.

posts.title: Well-Being Is About What Makes a Life Go Well

claims.claim: Well-being concerns how a life goes for its subject and is prudential rather than moral/aesthetic value.
claims.review: S9E2/S9E3/S9E8 and SEP section 1 support both distinctions.

claims.claim: Good for someone is distinct from morally admirable.
claims.review: S9E8/S9E9 and SEP section 1 support both turns.

posts.title: Canadian Jewish faculty say university EDI offices met them with silence after Oct. 7

claims.claim: Faculty/staff findings and student survey described as though they share a population.
claims.review: S6E7 explicitly identifies the federal survey as Jewish students. Page separates that from a faculty/staff study.

claims.claim: Jewish students report peers have low negativity toward them.
claims.review: S6E3/S6E4 are a national survey of university students' attitudes; the post changes what was measured and who reported it.

claims.claim: 70% of religion-targeted hate crimes in 2025 and about 1% of the population.
claims.review: S6E1/S6E2 and page support these denominators and year; S6E2 was retained for discussion rather than the body.

claims.claim: Hostility is directed at Israel, not Jewish individuals; EDI failure explained by political distinctions.
claims.review: Categorical exclusion is unsupported by aggregate attitudes and the page describes antisemitic incidents. The proposed causal explanation is speculative; remove it.

posts.title: NASA's COSI telescope will hunt gamma rays from antimatter and dying stars

claims.claim: COSI assembly, July 8 image, flex circuits, mission aims and named partners.
claims.review: Page supports the body. Saved body IDs select only starts of several sentences; July 8 and several continuation details are absent from those body IDs. Discussion retains additional aims/partner fragments.

claims.claim: Gamma-ray telescope rarity, focusing explanation, brief flashes, and a university-leading collaboration model.
claims.review: Selected S11E5-S11E8 and the NASA image article do not support this elaboration. Remove discussion rather than label it confirmed false.

posts.title: FAA to debut AI air-traffic advisor over Washington, D.C. as soon as Monday

claims.claim: SMART advisory role, four operational inputs, possible September 21 launch at three airports, planned 29-million-square-mile rollout and Mann's 17-year career.
claims.review: Full page supports the body with possible/planned qualifiers. Several details are not present in selected body snippets; some appear in retained discussion support.

claims.claim: World's most congested airspace and an implied near-miss-reduction evaluation.
claims.review: Superlative and safety effect are not established by the selected evidence or page. Replace with qualified interpretation of the limited rollout.

claims.claim: Advisory role and Mann's caution.
claims.review: Page supports advisory role/career; original claim that value depends entirely on controller trust overstates it. Keep narrower interpretation.

posts.title: What the American landscape looked like before the suburb took over

claims.claim: 1643 purchase and families arriving in 1644 under earlier Dutch control.
claims.review: Page supports those dates, names and sequence.

claims.claim: 1644 community centered on stores/pharmacies in gallery; pattern vanished with cars and federal funding.
claims.review: Post joins settlement history to much later gallery captions and claims disappearance where page describes transformation. Saved S9E10/S9E11 are captions, not chronology.

claims.claim: Current zoning recreation, billions spent reversing suburbs, and Main Street dated to 1910.
claims.review: Not supported by retained captions or article. Correct using the page's explicit rail/retail explanation, not an inferred photograph date.

posts.title: Virtual worlds boost robot real‑world training

claims.claim: Robot training systems are becoming more sophisticated.
claims.review: Exactly the one-sentence S1E1 evidence. Supported but little independent payoff for an explainer.

claims.claim: Rare-scenario rehearsal and simulated physics limiting transfer.
claims.review: Not supported by retained S1E1. Later full page discusses simulations/approximation, but that is not evidence the original model received. Omit discussion; do not falsely mark all elaboration factually wrong.

posts.title: Holdout juror insists Clancy guilty despite dissent

claims.claim: A lone juror wanted conviction and said others would not listen, attributed to his lawyer's statement.
claims.review: S2E1/S2E2 and PBS/AP page support this as the juror's claim, not a court finding. No discussion.

posts.title: After‑tax manufacturing profits surge, but adjusted measures tell a mixed story

claims.claim: After-tax profits versus inventory-adjusted profits and equipment expensing.
claims.review: S4E2/S4E3/S4E8 and page support the contrast, but the skeptical analysis belongs to Econbrowser's author, not Antoni.

claims.claim: After-tax surge establishes genuine manufacturing strength.
claims.review: Contrary to the caution in the cited analysis; opinion label does not establish productivity. Replace with the measure-versus-question distinction.

posts.title: Norval Morrisseau masterpiece returns after 40 years in storage
posts.currentPageVerification: timed out twice; retained support only

claims.claim: Morrisseau painting returns after 40 years in storage, Thunder Bay unveiling, loan from EA Studios Calgary and spiritual/powerful descriptions.
claims.review: S13E1/S13E2 support each claim and qualifier. CBC fresh retrieval timed out twice; no independent current-page verification. No discussion.

posts.title: Attorney General Blanche's Political Event Speeches Blur Justice Department Boundaries

claims.claim: Blanche political speeches depart from norms protecting DOJ's appearance of impartiality.
claims.review: S1E1/S1E2 and PBS/AP page support the report.

claims.claim: S1E1/S1E2 invoked as reader-facing authorities.
claims.review: Internal evidence narration; second turn is also circular and adds little. Remove optional block.

posts.title: Israeli Investment Growth in Cypriot Property Market

claims.claim: Three-year rise in Israeli property purchases/investment and permanent moves to Cyprus.
claims.review: S2E1 supports this. Subsequent narration of S2E2 is process leakage, not an explanation.

claims.claim: Investment shows growing opportunities and the teaser question implies mixed economic effects.
claims.review: S2E1/S2E2 do not establish those answers. Later full page has substantive reporting, but it is not retained input. Narrow copy to the supported statement and omit discussion.

posts.title: SageMaker AI 2026 Inference Capabilities and Deployment Paths
posts.currentPageVerification: timed out twice; retained support only

claims.claim: Model sizes, token-rate/latency language, cold starts, capacity/monitoring claims.
claims.review: S5E1 retains only the beginning of a long sentence. Several claims require continuations absent from selected support; page retrieval timed out.

claims.claim: Two deployment paths with detailed endpoint/HyperPod descriptions; thirteen 2026 capabilities.
claims.review: S5E3 retains instance-versus-token billing and existence of two paths; S5E6 supports thirteen capabilities. Detailed pathway names are not in retained snippets.

claims.claim: Endpoint and HyperPod operational claims with S5E references.
claims.review: Evidence-ID leakage plus unsupported retained details. Remove discussion; narrow title/body to independently inspectable retained claims. Do not certify or call missing details false.

posts.title: BetterHalf Films Boards Galeo of the Seawalkers at VIFF Business Hub

claims.claim: BetterHalf boards Fembriarto film, whose Indonesian title is Galeo Anak Segara, selected for new VIFF forum.
claims.review: S6E1/S6E2 and retrieved Variety opening support this. Original body runs the two titles together and narrates evidence IDs.

claims.claim: Co-production opportunity plus forum effectiveness for financing/distribution.
claims.review: First mostly repeats the body; second adds claims beyond retained support. Remove block and retain the corrected film report.
